comment: Default Debian/Ubuntu component recipe for Varin environments (execution-environment-design §6.2). Package names are Debian 13; each entry is a separately installable component so a pure work environment can skip the desktop group. Image/video/engineering/game software is deliberately absent — users or authorized agents install those per task.

components.title: Lightweight desktop, browser control surface
components.notes: One default browser: visible persistent Chromium, shared by users, URL handlers and the CDP bridge. Existing Firefox installations and profiles are retained; users can install another browser.

components.title: Documents and common data processing
components.notes: Office suite limited to the document trio plus a PDF renderer; scipy/sklearn, Java, LaTeX and OCR language packs stay per-task additions.
